finding: Containment drains a serial durable journal/anchor/witness path. Profiling located substantial repeated ACL utility-process overhead inside protected-anchor updates. Native held-handle DACL application and fresh proof remove that measured overhead while retaining separate stores and every durability boundary.
historical_limit: The exact physical trigger of the earlier full-suite timeout cannot be reconstructed from the archived data. The measurements below establish a code-level bottleneck and its removal; they do not identify that historical host condition.
source_hash_method: Raw hashes cover checked-out bytes observed by the selected phase probe; normalized text hashes decode UTF-8 and convert CRLF to LF. Baseline text comes directly from Git.

baseline_stage_profile.method: Pass-through perf_counter wrappers around original calls, with per-thread nesting subtraction. No tracing hook, deadline, policy or assertion changes.
baseline_stage_profile.interpretation: These three persistence stages were serial and non-overlapping on the response thread. The ACL total is nested inside Secrets.write_secret_map and must not be added again. _append_pinned_journal_bytes measures write/fsync/topology work together, not fsync alone. Other stage totals are parent-inclusive as labeled.

matched_native_acl_experiment.method: Matched inert files in baseline/native three-sample blocks, repeated twice (baseline3, native3, baseline3, native3); verbatim Git-baseline ACL helper and applied helper; original temp/replace/destination boundaries retained; each final DACL freshly checked.
matched_native_acl_experiment.baseline_helper_source: Verbatim _private_acl function extracted from the baseline Git source, with the same runtime dependencies.
matched_native_acl_experiment.cold_start_policy: All samples retained, including the first native invocation; no cold sample was discarded.
matched_native_acl_experiment.scope: Measured ACL boundaries on inert files, with actual native Windows operations. This is not whole-module throughput or a CPU/RAM-saving claim.

applied_integration.method: Same original comprehensive case and selected stage wrappers after the native ACL change; one fresh process, no concurrent agent test/build jobs.
applied_integration.receipt_assertion_scope: Original assertions required every expected quarantine/process identity; the fixture retained 36 file markers and all expected process identities. The selected probe observed all 39 response handlers; no synthetic success receipt was substituted.
applied_integration.durability_scope: The original 78 journal append phases, 79 protected-anchor updates and 79 independent witness updates remain. Both ACL callsites, DPAPI verification, atomic replacement, fsyncs, HMAC/rollback checks and exact target custody are unchanged.
applied_integration.timing_limit: This before/after integration is a small single-run observation. Other native-I/O stages varied too; the total case-time difference is not attributed solely to ACLs and is not a general latency guarantee.

scope: Exact protected DACL/full masks/trustees/owner proof and fresh no-mutation verification
Unsafe paths, hardlink/reparse cases, handle/descriptor faults and dependency-only fallback
Real Windows temp/rename ACL proof and actual DPAPI update retaining both ACL calls and fsync

rejected_checkpoint_overlap_experiment.status: Rejected and all experimental Actor/live-test changes removed before the applied native ACL gate.
rejected_checkpoint_overlap_experiment.reason: Concurrent independent checkpoint flushes did not improve matched native append latency on this volume.
rejected_checkpoint_overlap_experiment.method: Inert journal intents only; identical current persistence methods with actual Git-baseline advancement ordering versus joined current ordering. No host mutation.
rejected_checkpoint_overlap_experiment.conclusion: No checkpoint-concurrency change ships and no improvement is claimed from this experiment.

excluded_exploratory_probe: An initial simultaneous-worker cProfile attempt failed the existing readiness gate before containment admission and produced unusable cross-worker attribution. None of its timings are used in this proof.
limits: Controller snapshots describe requested policy only, not physical host load.
Native cleanup and durable storage remain OS/device dependent; the original deadline is not increased.
The proven target is unnecessary ACL process/permission-update overhead; exact historical physical causes remain unknown.
These are inert simulation fixtures, not a general production detection-efficacy or old-hardware performance guarantee.
